#!/usr/bin/env python3
from __future__ import annotations

import html
import os
import re
import urllib.request


BASE_URL = os.environ.get("CHUMMER_HUB_PLAYWRIGHT_BASE_URL", "http://127.0.0.1:8091").rstrip("/")


def fetch(path: str) -> tuple[str, str]:
    response = urllib.request.urlopen(f"{BASE_URL}{path}", timeout=20)
    final_url = response.geturl()
    body = response.read().decode("utf-8", errors="ignore")
    text = re.sub(r"<[^>]+>", " ", body)
    text = html.unescape(re.sub(r"\s+", " ", text)).strip()
    return final_url, text


def require_text(text: str, needle: str, label: str) -> None:
    if needle not in text:
        raise AssertionError(f"{label} should include {needle!r}.")


def main() -> int:
    final_url, contact = fetch("/contact")
    require_text(contact, "Open the right support case", "/contact")
    require_text(contact, "Direct support intake", "/contact")
    require_text(contact, "Guest submissions allowed", "/contact")
    require_text(contact, "Tracked follow-up with an account", "/contact")
    require_text(contact, "Open support intake", "/contact")
    require_text(contact, "Open account support", "/contact")
    if final_url != f"{BASE_URL}/contact":
        raise AssertionError(f"/contact should stay on its own route, got {final_url}.")

    final_url, help_text = fetch("/help")
    require_text(help_text, "Get help without guessing", "/help")
    require_text(help_text, "Support is separate from participation", "/help")
    require_text(help_text, "Open support intake", "/help")
    require_text(help_text, "Open downloads", "/help")
    require_text(help_text, "Create account", "/help")
    if final_url != f"{BASE_URL}/help":
        raise AssertionError(f"/help should stay on its own route, got {final_url}.")

    final_url, faq = fetch("/faq")
    require_text(faq, "Plain answers before you spend more time", "/faq")
    require_text(faq, "Open support intake", "/faq")
    require_text(faq, "Create account", "/faq")
    require_text(faq, "No GitHub required", "/faq")
    if final_url != f"{BASE_URL}/faq":
        raise AssertionError(f"/faq should stay on its own route, got {final_url}.")

    final_url, _ = fetch("/home/access")
    if final_url != f"{BASE_URL}/login?next=%2Fhome%2Faccess":
        raise AssertionError(f"/home/access should redirect to bounded login, got {final_url}.")

    final_url, _ = fetch("/account/support")
    if final_url != f"{BASE_URL}/login?next=%2Faccount%2Fsupport":
        raise AssertionError(f"/account/support should redirect to bounded login, got {final_url}.")

    print("support-case-flow: ok")
    return 0


if __name__ == "__main__":
    raise SystemExit(main())
